title: Hausdorff measure on the hyperplane v^⊥ is Lebesgue measure through an isometric parametrization
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and v ∈ ℝ^{m+1} with v ≠ 0 (ℝ^k := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)), and P_v := (span{v})^⊥. There is a linear isometry ι : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m+1} with ⟨ι x, v⟩ = 0 for every x such that the restriction of H^m = μHE[m] to P_v equals the push-forward ι_# L^m of Lebesgue measure L^m on ℝ^m.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1)), v ≠ 0 → ∃ ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1), (∀ x, inner ℝ (ι x) v = 0) ∧ (μHE[m] : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))).restrict ((Submodule.span ℝ {v})ᗮ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) = Measure.map ι volume
